0022600213.text: The Clippers (2-7, 0-4 on the road) visit the Phoenix Suns (3-5) for the Clippers' 10th game of the season, and the two teams have not met yet this season after splitting their 2025-26 series 2-2. The Clippers are without Bradley Beal (knee inflammation), Brandon Ingram (Achilles surgery), Jordan Miller (shoulder surgery), and Yanic Konan Niederhauser (foot surgery), and Cam Christie is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision. Phoenix is missing Jordan Goodwin (calf) and Mark Williams (shoulder surgery), and the Clippers won the last meeting 117-93 in Phoenix on February 1, 2026.
